title: Brexit: What has changed for the British, 10 years later?
summary: Ten years after the #Brexit vote, FRANCE 24's Revisited examines the impact of this historic decision. How has Brexit changed the country? Has the standard of living for Britons improved since then? What have been the consequences for the economy and key sectors such as agriculture?
